shared_elements: standing human figure in frontal or profile view
relief carving of figures on a vertical stone surface
elaborate headdress/headgear on a human figure
human figure holding a long staff-like object
decorative border band along the top edge
justification: Both depict standing human figures in relief with headgear, and A's figure holds a staff-like element while B's attendant grips a staff, but that is about the limit of the correspondence. A shows a single frontal, densely ornamented figure covered in interlocking masks, scrolls and glyph-like fillers with no ground line or narrative, whereas B shows a processional scene in profile with a naturalistically modelled two-humped animal led by human attendants along a plain ground band beneath a row of rosettes; the depictive conventions (horror vacui abstraction versus clean profile naturalism) are fundamentally different.
